name: Design-aware population estimation benchmark (NHANES)
description: Benchmark and reference implementation for evaluating whether large language models can compute design-weighted population quantities from complex survey microdata. The package contains 300 tasks, a 100-task replication set, the scoring code, and the raw model completions. Code is released under the MIT license; the derived benchmark data and completions are released under CC BY 4.0. Derived from public-use NHANES 2015-2016 and 2017-2018 files; no respondent-level records are redistributed.
